description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Debug class, which is a compile-time plugin for the Smarty templating engine that handles the {debug} tag. It generates PHP code to display the Smarty debugging console during template rendering.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Debug
classes.description: A class that compiles the {debug} tag to PHP code that displays the Smarty debugging console.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {debug} tag into PHP code that initializes and invokes the Smarty debug display.
